GLOBAL SAAS CAMPAIGN

CLIENT CloudSync Data
INDUSTRY Software / SaaS
SERVICES PPC, Meta Ads, Google Ads
WEBSITE cloudsync.io

Project Overview

CloudSync needed a massive push for their new enterprise tier. We crafted a targeted multi-channel advertising campaign spanning Meta, Google, and LinkedIn that drove a 300% increase in qualified enterprise leads within three months.

Breaking into the enterprise market required reaching C-suite decision makers across multiple touchpoints. The existing organic strategy wasn't generating enough high-value leads, and ad spend was being wasted on unqualified traffic from broad targeting.

We built hyper-targeted audience segments using LinkedIn job title data, implemented retargeting funnels across Meta and Google Display, and created compelling video ad creatives that showcased real customer success stories. A/B testing was continuous to optimize ROAS.
Let's discuss how we can help you reach your target audience and maximize your ad spend.

E-COMMERCE PLATFORM

CLIENT LuxeHaven
INDUSTRY Luxury Retail
SERVICES UI/UX, Branding, Shopify
WEBSITE luxehaven.com

Project Overview

LuxeHaven, a premium home decor brand, needed a complete e-commerce redesign to match their luxury positioning. We delivered an end-to-end Shopify store with custom UI/UX design that elevated the online shopping experience and boosted conversions by 60%.

Their existing store felt generic and failed to convey the premium quality of their products. High cart abandonment rates and poor mobile experience were costing significant revenue. The brand identity needed to translate seamlessly into the digital storefront.

We designed a bespoke Shopify theme with elegant typography, immersive product galleries, and a streamlined checkout flow. Custom animations and micro-interactions were added to create a memorable browsing experience that reflects the brand's luxury ethos.
Let's create a beautiful online store that converts visitors into loyal customers.

SEO & DIGITAL STRATEGY

CLIENT HealthFirst Clinics
INDUSTRY Healthcare
SERVICES SEO, Content, Analytics
WEBSITE healthfirst.com

Project Overview

HealthFirst Clinics needed to dominate local search results across 12 locations. We implemented a comprehensive SEO strategy including technical optimization, content marketing, and local SEO that achieved page-1 rankings for 50+ competitive healthcare keywords.

The healthcare industry is highly competitive in search. HealthFirst had poor domain authority, thin content, and no structured data markup. Their competitors were outranking them for critical patient-acquisition keywords in every local market.

We conducted in-depth keyword research, optimized all technical SEO factors (Core Web Vitals, schema markup, site architecture), created a medical content hub with 100+ expert-reviewed articles, and built high-authority backlinks through digital PR campaigns.
Let's build an SEO strategy that drives sustainable organic growth for your business.

MODERN REAL ESTATE PORTAL

CLIENT DataPulse Analytics
INDUSTRY Data & Analytics
SERVICES React, Node.js, APIs
WEBSITE datapulse.io

Project Overview

DataPulse needed a custom web application to replace their legacy dashboard system. We built a full-stack React + Node.js application with real-time data visualization, role-based access control, and seamless third-party API integrations.

The existing system was built on outdated technology that couldn't handle real-time data streams. Users reported frequent crashes during peak hours, and adding new data sources required weeks of development. The team needed a modern, scalable architecture.

We architected a React frontend with WebSocket connections for live data updates, paired with a Node.js/Express backend and PostgreSQL database. A modular plugin system was built so new data connectors could be added in hours instead of weeks. Docker containers ensure consistent deployment.
Let's build a powerful, scalable web app tailored to your business needs.

BRAND GROWTH CAMPAIGN

CLIENT FreshBite Foods
INDUSTRY Food & Beverage
SERVICES Instagram, Content, Influencer
WEBSITE freshbite.co

Project Overview

FreshBite Foods wanted to build a strong social media presence from scratch. We developed a comprehensive social media strategy across Instagram and TikTok that grew their follower base by 200% and engagement by 5x in just six months.

As a new brand in a saturated food market, FreshBite had zero social media presence and limited brand recognition. They needed to quickly build an authentic community around their healthy snack products and convert followers into paying customers.

We created a content calendar mixing recipe videos, behind-the-scenes stories, and user-generated content campaigns. Strategic influencer partnerships with micro-influencers in the health and wellness space drove authentic engagement. Instagram Shopping was integrated to enable direct purchases from posts.
Let's build a social media strategy that turns followers into loyal customers.

FINTECH APP REDESIGN

CLIENT PayFlow Inc.
INDUSTRY Financial Tech
SERVICES UI/UX, Frontend
WEBSITE payflow.com

Project Overview

PayFlow came to us with a dated application that was suffering from low user retention. The goal was to completely redesign the user interface and overhaul the frontend architecture to create a seamless, modern experience.
The main challenge was simplifying a complex set of financial tools into an intuitive dashboard without hiding critical data from power users.
We implemented a clean Claymorphism design system to give the interface depth while maintaining accessibility. Complex charts were broken down into digestible widgets.
Let's discuss how we can help you achieve outstanding results.
